mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 4% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods when UNRATE exceeds 4% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS YoY change falls below -3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index above 0.5% signals improving manufacturing output and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO rises above 0.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 25 basis point increase in the federal funds rate triggers a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by 0.25% in one month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative after a 25 bps FEDFUNDS increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 4% and a fall in average hourly earnings below 0% over the same month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4% and HOUST < 0% in the same month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) exceeding 3% combined with a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate above 4% signals severe demand contraction, which reduces corporate revenue growth and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS YoY change < -3% and UNRATE > 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an extended monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when FEDFUNDS < 2% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
